import requests, re, os
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def tsv(q,f):
    t=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",params={"query":q,"fields":f,"format":"tsv"},timeout=240).text
    ls=t.rstrip("\n").split("\n"); h=ls[0].split("\t")
    return pd.DataFrame([dict(zip(h,l.split("\t"))) for l in ls[1:]])
seq="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q12212.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
AAs="ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY"; idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAs)}

A=tsv("(organism_id:559292) AND (reviewed:true) AND (ft_signal:*)","accession,sequence,ft_signal")
B=tsv("(organism_id:559292) AND (reviewed:true) AND (ft_transmem:*) AND NOT (ft_signal:*)","accession,sequence,ft_transmem")
train=[];spseq=[]
for _,x in A.iterrows():
    m=re.search(r'SIGNAL (\d+)\.\.(\d+)',str(x["Signal peptide"])); s=x["Sequence"]
    if not m or not isinstance(s,str): continue
    c=int(m.group(2))
    if c<14 or c+2>len(s) or not set(s)<=set(AAs): continue
    train.append(s[c-13:c+2]); spseq.append(s)
bg=np.array([sum(s.count(a) for s in A.Sequence if isinstance(s,str)) for a in AAs],float); bg/=bg.sum()
M=np.zeros((15,20))
for j in range(15):
    col=[w[j] for w in train]
    for i,a in enumerate(AAs): M[j,i]=np.log(((col.count(a)+bg[i]*20)/(len(col)+20))/bg[i])
def score(s,site):
    w=s[site-13:site+2]
    return sum(M[j,idx[w[j]]] for j in range(15)) if len(w)==15 and set(w)<=set(AAs) else np.nan
def best_site(s,lo=14,hi=50):
    v=[(score(s,k),k) for k in range(lo,min(hi,len(s)-2)+1)]
    v=[t for t in v if not np.isnan(t[0])]
    return max(v) if v else (np.nan,np.nan)

sp_best=np.array([best_site(s)[0] for s in spseq]); sp_best=sp_best[~np.isnan(sp_best)]
an_seq=[]
for _,x in B.iterrows():
    s=x["Sequence"]; tms=re.findall(r'TRANSMEM (\d+)\.\.(\d+)',str(x["Transmembrane"]))
    if len(tms)!=1 or not isinstance(s,str) or len(s)<80 or int(tms[0][0])>40 or not set(s)<=set(AAs): continue
    an_seq.append(s)
an_best=np.array([best_site(s)[0] for s in an_seq]); an_best=an_best[~np.isnan(an_best)]
sia=best_site(seq); v=sia[0]
print("=== best von Heijne PSSM score in residues 14-50 ===")
print(f"SIA1: {v:.2f} at site {sia[1]}")
print(f"cleaved-SP set (n={len(sp_best)}): median {np.median(sp_best):.2f}  P(>= SIA1) = {np.mean(sp_best>=v):.3f}")
print(f"anchor set     (n={len(an_best)}): median {np.median(an_best):.2f}  P(>= SIA1) = {np.mean(an_best>=v):.3f}")
LR_pssm = np.mean(sp_best>=v)/np.mean(an_best>=v)
print(f"LR (SP : anchor) from PSSM best-site score = {LR_pssm:.2f}")
print(f"Mann-Whitney SP vs anchor best-site score: p = {stats.mannwhitneyu(sp_best,an_best)[1]:.2e}")

# ---------------- Bayesian combination ----------------
prior_sp = len(spseq)/(len(spseq)+len(an_seq))
rows=[("prior (yeast proteins with an N-terminal hydrophobic segment)", f"{len(spseq)} SP vs {len(an_seq)} anchors", prior_sp/(1-prior_sp), "SP"),
      ("n-region charge = +4 (res 1-12)", "P=0.0119 | SP ; P=0.0809 | anchor", 0.0119/0.0809, "anchor"),
      ("Phobius call = 'cleaved SP, no TM'", "sens 66.7% on 33 true SPs ; 24.3% false-SP on 70 anchors", 0.667/0.243, "SP"),
      ("best von Heijne PSSM site score = %.2f"%v, f"P(>=)|SP={np.mean(sp_best>=v):.3f} ; |anchor={np.mean(an_best>=v):.3f}", LR_pssm, "SP" if LR_pssm>1 else "anchor"),
      ("N-terminal hydrophobicity KD 1.44", "24th pct of SPs, 23rd pct of anchors", 1.0, "neutral")]
odds=1.0; tab=[]
for nm,det,lr,fav in rows:
    odds*=lr
    tab.append([nm,det,f"{lr:.2f}",fav,f"{odds:.3f}",f"{odds/(1+odds)*100:.0f}%"])
print("\n=== Sequential Bayesian combination, odds expressed as SP : anchor ===")
print(pd.DataFrame(tab,columns=["evidence","detail","LR (SP:anchor)","favours","running odds","P(cleaved SP)"]).to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nFinal: posterior P(cleaved soluble SP) = {odds/(1+odds)*100:.0f}%,  P(uncleaved signal anchor) = {1/(1+odds)*100:.0f}%")
print("CAVEAT: these features are NOT independent (Phobius already uses charge and hydrophobicity),")
print("so the product overstates confidence. The honest read is 'close to even, no decisive call'.")

# ---------------- figure ----------------
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16,4.6))
a=ax[0]
a.hist(sp_best,bins=30,alpha=.6,density=True,color="#3182ce",label=f"cleaved SP (n={len(sp_best)})")
a.hist(an_best,bins=30,alpha=.6,density=True,color="#dd6b20",label=f"N-terminal anchor (n={len(an_best)})")
a.axvline(v,color="#c53030",lw=2.5,label=f"SIA1 best site = {v:.2f} (res {sia[1]})")
a.axvline(score(seq,35),color="#718096",ls="--",lw=2,label=f"Phobius site 35 = {score(seq,35):.2f}")
a.set_xlabel("best von Heijne PSSM score, residues 14-50"); a.set_ylabel("density"); a.legend(fontsize=7)
a.set_title("A. Cleavage-site quality: SIA1 res 27 is plausible\nbut mediocre; Phobius' res 35 is poor",fontsize=10)

b=ax[1]
cats=["TM\n(correct)","SP\n(ERROR)","SP+TM","none"]; vals=[47,17,2,4]
b.bar(cats,vals,color=["#38a169","#c53030","#d69e2e","#a0aec0"])
for i,val in enumerate(vals): b.text(i,val+1,str(val),ha="center",fontsize=9)
b.set_ylabel("number of proteins"); b.set_ylim(0,55)
b.set_title("B. Phobius on 70 yeast N-terminal single-TM anchors:\n24.3% (95% CI 14.8-36.0) wrongly called cleaved SP",fontsize=10)

c=ax[2]
labels=[r[0].split("(")[0].strip()[:30] for r in rows]; lrs=[float(t[2]) for t in tab]
colors=["#3182ce" if l>1 else ("#dd6b20" if l<1 else "#a0aec0") for l in lrs]
c.barh(range(len(lrs)),[np.log10(l) for l in lrs],color=colors)
c.set_yticks(range(len(lrs))); c.set_yticklabels(labels,fontsize=7.5)
c.axvline(0,color="k",lw=.8); c.set_xlabel("log10 LR   (<0 favours anchor, >0 favours cleaved SP)")
c.set_title(f"C. Evidence balance: posterior P(cleaved SP) = {odds/(1+odds)*100:.0f}%\nno decisive call; features are not independent",fontsize=10)
c.invert_yaxis()
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

out="/agent/jobs/914faa67-de09-4ee8-aff3-1f7b6c95106a/provenance"; os.makedirs(out,exist_ok=True)
pd.DataFrame(tab,columns=["evidence","detail","LR_SP_vs_anchor","favours","running_odds","P_cleaved_SP"]).to_csv(f"{out}/SIA1_bayesian_topology_table.tsv",sep="\t",index=False)
print("\nwrote", f"{out}/SIA1_bayesian_topology_table.tsv")
